items.title: OpenAI’s CFO Just Explained Why Nvidia Is No Longer the Only Option
items.summary: OpenAI's CFO just revealed how $122 billion in cash fundamentally changes the power dynamic between the world's most important AI lab and its chip suppliers, and the implications for Nvidia's premium pricing are only beginning to surface.

items.title: This AI Stock Could Be Worth Far More Than Investors Think
items.summary: Broadcom just posted AI revenue growth of 221% year over year and guided for even bigger numbers ahead, yet the stock sits well off its highs and trades at a fraction of its closest custom-chip rival's multiple. Something in that math does not add up.

items.title: ASML Vs. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing: One Is More Misunderstood
items.summary: Both ASML and TSMC crushed Q2 expectations, yet investors keep misreading what actually drives each business. The real story lives in two overlooked monopolies that most earnings headlines never touch.

items.title: Wall Street Sees 56% Upside in Broadcom After Summer Selloff
items.summary: Broadcom posted record AI chip numbers and Wall Street still hammered the stock, leaving analysts pointing to a gap between price and target that rarely opens this wide on a mega-cap. Here is what the sell side is betting the market is missing.

items.title: Think Nvidia Is Overpriced? The Irony Keeps Me Buying Again and Again
items.summary: Every time the overpriced chorus grows louder on Nvidia, one investor adds more shares, and the reasoning behind that move cuts against almost everything the skeptics keep quoting.

items.title: The AI Stock That Could Beat NVIDIA by 2027
items.summary: AMD just handed OpenAI, Meta, and Anthropic gigawatt-scale reasons to abandon NVIDIA, and Lisa Su is making a bold promise about 2027 that Wall Street has not fully priced in yet.

items.title: Can Intel pull off a 100% rally from here? This analyst thinks so
items.summary: Investing.com -- In a note to clients on Wednesday, Melius Research made the case that Intel shares could roughly double from current levels, arguing the chipmaker's foundry business is becoming increasingly valuable amid an AI-driven scramble for domestic chip production.

items.title: 2 S&P 500 Stocks for Long-Term Investors and 1 Facing Challenges
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.
